scenarios.title: Same-property reorder, cross-property move, persistence, and one-step undo
steps: Reorder alpha and beta and move one value between po_source and po_target
Use Undo and Redo without first focusing the note body
Wait for persistence and compare the final YAML while preserving the body
Repeat one guarded move while the acceptance controller changes the disposable fixture after the operation begins
expected: The editor, visible Properties view, and disk YAML converge after one host turn
Unrelated properties, comments, quoting, newline semantics, and body text remain intact
Touch and desktop interaction retain native actions, and the externally changed fixture fails closed without overwriting either version

scenarios.title: Value suggestion settings, ordering, native actions, and confirmed commits
steps: Open Value Suggestions.md and enable value suggestion ordering in the four-tab settings surface
Compare Native and Name ordering and apply the fixture per-property pinned, bottom and hidden rules
Choose a visible candidate, verify the committed YAML, then compare Recently used and Note count modes
Check that ordinary context menus retain their actions and disable enhancement to restore native behavior
expected: General, Value order, Key suggestions and Value suggestions are accessible at desktop and mobile widths
Only native property-value suggestions change; selected values persist to YAML and cancelled interactions do not enter recent history
Per-property rules remain separate from key rules; native actions and existing value dragging remain usable
